title: Android Developers Blog is moving

content:
Posted by the Android Developers Team




Today, we are closing this chapter on Blogger and moving all official news and engineering insights directly to developer.android.com/blog. The new blog will have improved formatting, tighter integration with our technical content and be easier to navigate.

Update your bookmarks and RSS today.

Happy Coding!
